newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: IMF deal seen pushing Pakistani stocks higher.
newsitem.headline: IMF deal seen pushing Pakistani stocks higher.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to surge after the International Monetary Fund announced plans to resume a stalled $600 million standby loan, dealers said on Thursday.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 10.52 points, or 0.73 percent, to end at 1,455.76. The index had soared to 1,469.61 in early trade, but profit-taking near the close took the steam out of the bull-run.
Gainers led losers 128 to 80. Turnover rose to 42.07 million shares from 36.66 million in the previous session.
Faysal Bank rose 0.15 rupees to 22.70 rupees and Adamjee Insurance 1.25 to 90.25. Dewan Salman Fibre rose 0.95 to 33.10. Cherat Cement rose 0.75 to 20.75.
Hub Power Co rose 0.45 to 34.30 and Pakistan State Oil 4.0 to 346. Pak Datacom Ltd rose 0.45 to 8.25 and PTCL 0.35 to 32.40. ICI Pakistan rose 0.20 to 18.25.
